mapper.sql: w.id AS workplaceId, w.status AS status, w.latitude AS latitude, w.longitude AS longitude, w.radius_meters AS radiusMeters, qr.id AS qrTokenId, qr.token_nonce AS tokenNonce
FROM workplaces w LEFT JOIN qr_tokens qr ON qr.workplace_id = w.id AND qr.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE w.id = #{workplaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT wc.id AS workCaseId, CASE WHEN wc.status = 'READY' THEN 'CHECK_IN' WHEN wc.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'CHECK_OUT' END AS scanType FROM work_cases wc WHERE wc.worker_id = #{workerId} AND wc.workplace_id = #{workplaceId} AND ( (wc.status = 'READY' AND wc.starts_at <= #{readyAt} AND wc.starts_at > #{noShowAfter}) OR (wc.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND wc.ends_at > #{checkoutAfter} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records check_in WHERE check_in.work_case_id = wc.id AND check_in.attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND check_in.result = 'SUCCESS' )) ) ORDER BY wc.starts_at, wc.id
SELECT id AS workCaseId, worker_id AS workerId, workplace_id AS workplaceId, status AS status, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt FROM work_cases WHERE id = #{workCaseId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_records (work_case_id, worker_id, qr_token_id, attendance_type, captured_at, attempted_at, distance_meters, accuracy_meters, result, failure_reason, early_checkout_confirmed_at) VALUES (#{workCaseId}, #{workerId}, #{qrTokenId}, #{attendanceType}, #{capturedAt}, #{attemptedAt}, #{distanceMeters}, #{accuracyMeters}, #{result}, #{failureReason}, #{earlyCheckoutConfirmedAt})
